headline: 300k followers lost: Actress Pearl Mani faces backlash over student protests
summary: The Malayalam actress lost over 300,000 Instagram followers in just two days after posting about student movements in India.
details: Malayalam actress Pearl Mani faced severe criticism after posting on Instagram regarding student protests in India.
Following her post on July 24, her follower count dropped from 2.7 million to approximately 2.4 million within just two days.
Despite calling for the safety and peace of students, the actress eventually disabled comments on her posts.
The controversy deepened when she later mocked a 'failed filmmaker' and stated that 'saffron is my favorite color,' sparking further debate online.
caption:
From 2.7 million to 2.4 million. A single Instagram post about student protests cost an actress 300,000 followers in 48 hours.

headline: 2 killed as detached train wagons ram into vehicles in Rajbari
summary: A freight train carrying oil separated, leaving wagons behind that crushed an auto-rickshaw and a Mahindra after the crossing gate was lifted.
details: Two people were killed and at least six others injured when detached wagons of a freight train collided with three vehicles at the Khankhanapur rail crossing in Rajbari Sadar upazila on Sunday night.
The deceased were identified as Abdul Malek Sheikh, 46, and Monowar Hossain, 45, according to police.
The accident occurred around 8:40 PM when a freight train carrying oil from Faridpur's Dhuldi power plant became separated, leaving four wagons behind its engine and first coach.
After the front section of the train passed, the gateman lifted the barrier, allowing a bus, an auto-rickshaw, and a Mahindra to enter the tracks.
The detached wagons then rammed into the vehicles, crushing the auto-rickshaw and Mahindra while partially damaging the bus.
Local residents rescued eight injured persons and transported them to Faridpur Medical College Hospital.
One victim died on the way to the hospital, while the other was declared dead on arrival.
caption:
A rail crossing gate was lifted while four detached train wagons were still on the tracks, killing 2 and injuring 6.

Two people were killed and at least six others injured when detached wagons of a freight train collided with three vehicles at the Khankhanapur rail crossing in Rajbari Sadar upazila on Sunday night.

The deceased were identified as Abdul Malek Sheikh, 46, and Monowar Hossain, 45, according to police.

The accident occurred around 8:40 PM when a freight train carrying oil from Faridpur's Dhuldi power plant became separated, leaving four wagons behind its engine and first coach.

After the front section of the train passed, the gateman lifted the barrier, allowing a bus, an auto-rickshaw, and a Mahindra to enter the tracks.

The detached wagons then rammed into the vehicles, crushing the auto-rickshaw and Mahindra while partially damaging the bus.

Local residents rescued eight injured persons and transported them to Faridpur Medical College Hospital.

One victim died on the way to the hospital, while the other was declared dead on arrival.
